portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL10.0 - libekmfweb: Fix gen of cert or CSR to use RSA not RSA-PSS (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-10.1.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115830)

* RHEL10.0 - chpstat: Fix DPU utilization scaling in reports (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-10.1.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115839)
